question: Estimate the GMV per customer per year on Amazon India for a Prime member.
idealClarificationQuestions: GMV (gross merchandise value) per Prime member per year? Yes.
All categories (e-commerce + Fresh + electronics + apparel)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total Prime GMV / total Prime members.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Amazon India total GMV: ~₹2.7 lakh Cr (FY26).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Amazon Prime India members: ~3-3.5 crore HH.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Avg orders per Prime member per year: ~25.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~₹60,000-65,000 annual GMV per Amazon India Prime member household.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Avg orders per Prime member per year

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~₹60,000-65,000 annual GMV per Amazon India Prime member household.

calculationFlow: Amazon India total GMV: ~₹2.7 lakh Cr (FY26).
Of this, Prime members drive ~70-75% of GMV = ₹2 lakh Cr.
Amazon Prime India members: ~3-3.5 crore HH.
GMV per Prime member household: ₹2 lakh Cr / 3.25 cr = ~₹61,500/year/HH.
Round: ~₹60,000-65,000 annual GMV per Amazon India Prime member household.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~₹60,000-65,000 annual GMV per Amazon India Prime member household.
